wiki.title: Norman W. Sanderson
wiki.extract: Norman Wesley Sanderson Jr. (born July 7, 1951) is a Republican member of the North Carolina General Assembly, representing the state's second Senate district, which includes Carteret, Craven, and Pamlico counties. Sanderson formerly represented the state's 3rd House district, which included parts of Craven and Pamlico counties.
